text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After finishing up a training session with

Kawakami Princess...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Wait right there, you big old moon!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The moon? Oh my! It's so big and round
tonight!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It looks like a big, white dumpling,
right? Looking
at it makes me want to
chase after it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I used to do that when I was
younger,
trying to imitate Princess
Kaguya. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If I was really her, I could actually run to
the
moon and back!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! Now I've got the urge to run like
wild! My
legs are just itching to go!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Then should we chase after the moon
together?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's. ♪ Is it okay if I let loose a bit,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's what I wanted to hear! Now then,
I'm going
to blast ahead faster than a
meteor!
choice_data_list: You really need to rest for today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two racers spend the rest of the
night chasing
after the moon, right up
until curfew!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I guess it's not very princess-like
to go
dashing off on impulse.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Aw, that's a shame. But this won't be the
last full
moon we ever see, so we can
always chase it next
time. ☆

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. We'll let it off the hook for now,
but the
next time we meet, that moon's
going down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two return to their dorm while the
shining
moon watches silently from
above.
